newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland near selecting motorway tender winner.
newsitem.headline: Poland near selecting motorway tender winner.

text.p: The government's Motorway Construction Agency will soon choose the winner of a tender to build a 364 km stretch of Poland's toll motorway scheme, the agency spokeswoman said on Wednesday.

Anna Jarucka told Reuters that the tender commission would meet later this week to discuss which of the two shortlisted bidders should get a licence to build the motorway connecting the German border with the central city of Lodz.
She said the commission would decide at the meeting when the winner would be named. The bidders in the motorway tender are Autostrady Polskie SA and Euroroute Polska SA.
Autostrady Polskie SA is a consortium of French firm Transroute Int., Germany's Strabag GmBH and three Polish companies -- Elektrim, Impexmetal SA and Kulczyk Holding SA.
Euroroute groups Bilfinger und Berger Bau from Germany and Spanish Dragados y Construciones SA.
Poland plans to build 2,500 kilometres of toll expressways over the next 15 years.

Under the programme, passed by parliament in 1994, consortia of Polish and foreign firms are invited to join in public tenders to build sections of motorways, where they will be allowed to collect tolls for 25 to 30 years.
The total cost of the construction is estimated at $8 billion. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
